THE DIRECTION

An inverted band carries the figures; the body below stays plain so the band keeps its force. Tokens are the repo's own — tweakcn "Glasser", monochrome, with amber/red/green reserved for state. Poppins + Kode Mono.

TWO ALTERNATES — pick one, or tell me which parts to take from each.

Alt A trades the band for air: one enormous figure, a plain-English summary, findings as a hairline list. Calmer, fewer numbers visible at once.

Alt B is the opposite: a light grey canvas of white cards, everything on one screen with no scrolling, a sparkline on traffic. Denser, more dashboard than document.
Every figure here is real, measured against the live API for stripe.com: DR 95, 3.2M estimated organic visits, 117.7K ranking keywords.
